title: #201 Practical Training
prompt: Some people think that universities should not provide so much theoretical knowledge but give more practical training throughout their courses. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?

promptSegments.text: Some people think that universities should not provide so much theoretical knowledge but give more practical training throughout their courses.
To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Practical training is crucial because it prepares students for the demands of the real world and makes them job-ready upon graduation.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Practical training is crucial because it prepares students for the demands of the real world and makes them job-ready upon graduation.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Acquiring practical skills helps students secure good jobs because employers value candidates who can contribute immediately.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Acquiring practical skills helps students secure good jobs because employers value candidates who can contribute immediately.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: University education is crucial because it provides students with a strong base of knowledge, which helps them think clearly and make good choices in daily life, as demonstrated by learning history to understand current events.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: University education is crucial because it provides students with a strong base of knowledge, which helps them think clearly and make good choices in daily life, as demonstrated by learning history to understand current events.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Although practical training is useful, academic study is vital because learning facts and ideas strengthens the mind, enabling students to understand complex ideas better, which is necessary for success.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Although practical training is useful, academic study is vital because learning facts and ideas strengthens the mind, enabling students to understand complex ideas better, which is necessary for success.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Practical training is crucial because it allows students to apply what they learn in real-world situations, building confidence and problem-solving abilities necessary for a good career start.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Practical training is crucial because it allows students to apply what they learn in real-world situations, building confidence and problem-solving abilities necessary for a good career start.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, practical courses enhance the learning experience by keeping students engaged and motivated, making the process feel more like preparation than a test.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, practical courses enhance the learning experience by keeping students engaged and motivated, making the process feel more like preparation than a test.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Theoretical knowledge is crucial because academic study builds a strong foundation of ideas and concepts, enabling students to think critically about complex issues.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Theoretical knowledge is crucial because academic study builds a strong foundation of ideas and concepts, enabling students to think critically about complex issues.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, theoretical knowledge helps students prepare for diverse careers because employers value a broad base of understanding, allowing adaptation to new technologies.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, theoretical knowledge helps students prepare for diverse careers because employers value a broad base of understanding, allowing adaptation to new technologies.
